# Vendored files

Bundled so the Orca plugin and the desktop app work offline. Each keeps its own license.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `three.min.js`, `OrbitControls.js` | three.js r147 | MIT |
| `fonts/*.woff2` | Bricolage Grotesque, Instrument Sans, Fredoka, Lilita One, Bungee, Pacifico (via Fontsource) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `neutralino.js` | Neutralinojs client 6.10 | MIT |

`src/spoolmandb.json` is a snapshot of [SpoolmanDB](https://github.com/Donkie/SpoolmanDB) (MIT).
